items.title: 微型金融違約增加 裕融：增提備抵 資產品質穩健可控
items.title_en: Microfinance Defaults Rise, Yurun: Increased Provisions, Asset Quality Remains Stable and Controllable
paras: 裕融企業(9941-TW)最新指出，企金事業有看到企業融資和微型金融違約增加，使台灣延滯率回升至1.65%，惟已增提備抵反映風險，且部分大型違約個案擔保品充足，屬實質無損案件，整體資產品質保持穩健且在可控範圍，今(20)日盤中股價相對抗跌。
裕融表示，今年前三季業務動能增溫、資產品質穩定改善且有效成本管理，使獲利穩健成長，截至第三季合併總資產達2964.1億元，較去年同期成長4.7%，而預期信用減損損失大幅年減29%。台灣消金事業資產品質持續改善，已回穩至2022年優良時期水準。
而儘管企金事業雖受企業融資和微型金融違約增加影響，台灣延滯率回升至1.65%，但裕融表示，已增提備抵反映風險，且部分大型違約個案擔保品充足，是實質無損案件，整體資產品質仍保持穩健且在可控範圍。
在中國，裕融說明，延滯率由去年同期的3.15%降至2.25%，新承作案件資產品質已顯著改善，惟當地執行時程仍較緩，呆帳回收效益將遞延顯現。
裕融進一步提到，中國景氣復甦有限、租賃市場競爭加劇壓縮利差空間，所幸資金成本降低且費用控管良好，使前三季在中國的營業利益達1.58億元，較去年同期倍增，未來將聚焦優質客群，穩固資產品質。
而東南亞的投資也值得期待，裕融持續增資產、擴收益，對整體獲利的貢獻度正逐步放大。
paras_en: Yurun Enterprise (9941-TW) recently noted that its corporate finance unit has observed an increase in corporate financing and micro‑finance defaults, causing Taiwan's delinquency rate to climb back to 1.65%. However, the company has raised provisions to reflect the risk, and the collateral for several large default cases is sufficient, making them essentially non‑loss events. Overall asset quality remains sound and within controllable limits, and the stock price held up relatively during midday trading on the 20th.

Yurun said that in the first three quarters of this year, business momentum warmed, asset quality improved steadily, and effective cost management led to solid profit growth. As of the third quarter, total consolidated assets reached NT$296.41 billion, up 4.7% year‑on‑year, and expected credit loss provisions are projected to drop sharply by 29% annually. The consumer finance segment in Taiwan continues to see asset quality improve, returning to the strong levels seen in 2022.

Although the corporate finance unit was affected by the rise in corporate financing and micro‑finance defaults, pushing Taiwan's delinquency rate up to 1.65%, Yurun emphasized that it has increased provisions to reflect the risk and that collateral for several large default cases is ample, rendering them essentially non‑loss events. Consequently, overall asset quality remains robust and within controllable bounds.

In China, Yurun explained that the delinquency rate fell from 3.15% in the same period last year to 2.25%. The quality of newly originated loan assets has improved markedly, though local execution timelines remain slower, delaying the realization of bad‑debt recovery benefits.

Yurun added that the economic recovery in China is limited and intensified competition in the leasing market is compressing margin space. Fortunately, lower funding costs and good expense control helped operating profit in China reach NT$158 million in the first three quarters, more than double the figure from a year earlier. Going forward, the company will focus on high‑quality customers to further solidify asset quality.
Investment in Southeast Asia also looks promising. Yurun continues to increase assets and expand earnings, and its contribution to overall profitability is gradually growing.

items.title: 台股湧多殺多無差別賣壓 國家隊死守台積電2000元、台幣33元防線
items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks See Broad Sell‑off as Both Bulls and Bears Dump, State‑Backed Funds Defend TSMC at NT$2,000 and NT$33 Levels
paras: 台股加權指數今(20)日盤中重挫超過2200點，直接摜破38000、37000點關卡，甚至恐陷入36000點保衛戰，創4月中旬以來新低，跌停家數超過300家，統一投顧分析，盤面因籌碼宣洩未止，引發多殺多無差別賣壓，中長期技術面偏弱勢，底部尚未見到型態確認。
台股加權指數盤中跌幅超過6%，櫃買指數更跌達7.6%，而新台幣開盤即貶破33元價位，最低見到33.04元，與昨日的低點持平顯示中央銀行死守。
其中，千金股中亮跌停燈號的有創意(3443-TW)、健策(3653-TW)、旺矽(6223-TW)、智邦(2345-TW)等，護國神山台積電(2330-TW)也陷入2000元關卡保衛戰。
統一投顧指出，Anthropic 掛牌首日雖大漲約 17%，仍未能化解市場對 AI投資獲利能力、龐大資本支出和融資風險的疑慮，同時，AMD 董事長、總裁兼執行長蘇姿丰於11月 16 日共出售70000 股普通股，加深市場投資人對AI疑慮。
從技術面來看，由於加權指數失守年線，技術指標KD、RSI向下，MACD 維持綠柱體，整體技術面弱勢整理，雖台股短線負乖離率大，加上昨日上市櫃融資大減逾 300億元，浮額大清洗後隨時醞釀短線反彈契機，但提防仍具有一定風險，中長期技術面偏弱勢，尚未能確認底部型態，建議投資人靜待止穩訊號。
paras_en: The Taiwan Capitalization Weighted Index plunged more than 2,200 points during today’s (20th) session, breaking through the 38,000 and 37,000 point thresholds and even threatening a battle to hold above 36,000 points, hitting a new low not seen since mid‑April. Over 300 stocks hit their daily limit down, and Uni-President Securities notes that the market’s sell‑off continued unabated as capital‑flow relief failed to materialise, creating indiscriminate selling pressure from both long and short positions. The medium‑ to long‑term technical outlook remains weak, and a bottom pattern has not yet been confirmed.

The weighted index fell more than 6% intraday, while the OTC index dropped 7.6%. The New Taiwan dollar opened weaker, slipping below the NT$33 mark and touching a low of NT$33.04, matching yesterday’s low and indicating the central bank’s staunch defence of the currency.

Among the so‑called “thousand‑dollar stocks,” the ones that flashed a limit‑down signal included Creative (3443‑TW), Health Strategy (3653‑TW), Wang Silicon (6223‑TW) and Chipbond (2345‑TW). Even the national champion TSMC (2330‑TW) found itself fighting to stay above the NT$2,000 level.

Uni‑President Securities points out that although Anthropic surged about 17% on its debut day, it did not allay market concerns over AI investment profitability, massive capital expenditures and financing risks. At the same time, AMD chairman, president and CEO Lisa Su sold 70,000 shares of common stock on November 16, deepening investors’ AI‑related worries.

From a technical perspective, the weighted index has slipped below its yearly moving average, with the KD and RSI indicators turning down and the MACD remaining in negative (green) bars, indicating overall weak consolidation. Although the market shows a large short‑term negative divergence and yesterday’s listed‑company margin financing shrank by more than NT$30 billion, the massive cleanup of floating shares could set the stage for a short‑term rebound. Nevertheless, risks remain, the medium‑ to long‑term technical outlook stays weak, a bottom pattern is still unconfirmed, and investors are advised to wait for a stabilising signal.

items.title: 〈分析〉14.5倍明年營收估值貴過SpaceX Anthropic上市狂歡能撐多久？
items.title_en: Analysis: Is a 14.5‑Times‑Next‑Year‑Revenue Valuation More Expensive Than SpaceX? How Long Can Anthropic’s IPO Euphoria Last?
paras: 人工智慧新創公司Anthropic (Anthropic) (ANT-US) 19日在那斯達克掛牌，上市首日開盤價達111.50美元，較83美元發行價大漲34%，盤中完全稀釋估值一度衝破2兆美元。然而，亮眼的上市表現背後，營收成長放緩、模型定價能力下降及龐大算力支出等問題，正讓這場AI資本狂歡面臨考驗。
《路透Breakingviews》專欄作家Karen Kwok同日撰文指出，Anthropic上市首日的高估值，可能掩蓋其商業模式尚未穩固的問題。投資人願意以高價買進，卻正值公司成長動能出現降溫跡象，未來能否將龐大融資轉化為持續獲利，仍有很大不確定性。
以111.50美元開盤價計算，Anthropic估值相當於下一財政年度預估營收的14.5倍，相關營收預測來自Needham與Morningstar。相較之下，馬斯克旗下SpaceX (SpaceX) (SPCX-US) 同期股價約為預估營收的9倍，數據來自Visible Alpha。
雖然兩家公司採用的營收預估來源不同，並非完全相同基準的比較，但Kwok認為，Anthropic目前的定價仍明顯偏高。換言之，投資人不只是在押注公司未來成長，也必須接受其估值已提前反映相當樂觀的營收預期。
市場更在意的是，Anthropic的高速成長是否開始減速。根據招股文件，公司2026年前九個月營收年增率超過1,100%，但營收季增率已從前一季的144%降至47%，顯示即使營收仍快速擴張，成長速度已不如先前。
企業客戶的AI支出數據也出現值得留意的訊號。Kwok引用企業支出管理平台Ramp追蹤資料指出，截至11月15日當週，受追蹤企業在Anthropic模型上的Token支出，較一個月前僅增加3%，反映企業使用模型的支出動能可能正在放緩。
不過，這項數據的觀測期間與發布時間均早於Anthropic上市，樣本也僅涵蓋Ramp追蹤的企業，不能直接代表Anthropic全部客戶的支出，更不能據此認定公司整體營收已經停滯。但對一家估值已達兆美元級別、必須持續維持高速成長的企業而言，企業端使用量增幅縮小，仍是市場需要關注的警訊。
除了使用量增長，模型定價能力也面臨壓力。Kwok指出，Anthropic每個Token的收費價格持續下滑，代表公司可能逐漸失去定價能力。若模型服務價格不斷下降，即使客戶使用量增加，也未必能等比例轉化為營收與利潤。
獲利表現則進一步凸顯這項挑戰。Anthropic營業利益率從第二季的8%轉為第三季負3%，部分原因是能源成本大幅上升。這意味著，公司雖然仍能快速擴大營收，但運算與基礎設施成本也可能侵蝕獲利空間。
更沉重的壓力來自長期資本支出。根據招股文件，Anthropic已承諾約9,000億美元的晶片、雲端服務及資料中心相關支出，其中超過700億美元將在2026年9月之後的12個月內到期。
這些支出是維持模型訓練、推理服務及未來算力供應的重要基礎，但也形成龐大的資金與履約壓力。若企業客戶使用量持續成長，公司或許能透過規模擴張分攤成本；但若需求增速放緩、模型價格持續下降，固定的算力採購與基礎設施承諾就可能壓縮利潤。
Anthropic上市首日的股價走勢，也顯示市場並非毫無疑慮。股價開盤一度大漲34%，盤中完全稀釋估值突破2兆美元，但隨後漲幅收斂，股價一度跌破111.50美元的開盤價，反映部分投資人選擇在上市首日獲利了結。
同一交易日，半導體與AI基礎設施相關股票也承受壓力。截至Kwok專欄發布時，輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US) 與博通 (Broadcom) (AVGO-US) 股價均下跌1.6%；AI雲端運算業者CoreWeave (CoreWeave) (CRWV-US) 下跌3.1%，Nebius (Nebius) (NBIS-US) 更下跌6%。
市場波動也加深投資人對AI產業估值的疑慮。衡量美股市場恐慌情緒的VIX指數，當週維持在25以上，代表市場避險情緒偏高。在這種環境下，Anthropic雖然成功完成大型IPO，卻未必能單靠上市首日的亮眼表現，消除市場對AI產業獲利能力與資本支出的擔憂。
Kwok認為，Anthropic是首家上市的大型機器學習模型開發商，未來每一季財報都將成為公開市場檢驗AI商業模式的重要依據。投資人將能持續追蹤營收成長、模型使用量、定價能力、營業利益率及算力支出，判斷AI企業究竟能否將技術優勢轉化為長期獲利。
對整個AI產業而言，Anthropic的上市首日大漲，或許能暫時為市場注入信心，延續資料中心與AI伺服器投資熱潮。但當企業支出增速放緩、模型價格持續下降，而基礎設施承諾仍高達數千億美元，市場終究必須面對一個問題：AI產業的營收成長，是否足以支撐如此龐大的資本投入？
Anthropic上市後，這個問題將不再只是私募市場的估值辯論，而會直接反映在每季財報與股價表現上。首日的2兆美元估值固然耀眼，但能否建立可持續的獲利模式，才是這場AI狂歡能否延續的真正關鍵。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic (ANT‑US) listed on Nasdaq on the 19th, opening at $111.50 – a 34% jump from its $83 issue price – and its fully‑diluted market cap briefly topped $2 trillion during the session. Yet behind the dazzling debut lie slowing revenue growth, weakening pricing power and massive compute spending, casting doubt on the AI capital frenzy.

Reuters Breakingviews columnist Karen Kwok wrote that Anthropic’s lofty first‑day valuation may mask an unsettled business model. Investors are paying a premium just as the company’s growth momentum shows signs of cooling, leaving great uncertainty over whether its huge financing can be turned into sustained profit.

At the $111.50 opening price, Anthropic’s valuation equals about 14.5 times its projected revenue for the next fiscal year, based on forecasts from Needham and Morningstar. By contrast, Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX‑US) traded at roughly 9 times its estimated revenue, according to Visible Alpha.

Although the two firms use different revenue‑forecast sources and the comparison is not perfectly apples‑to‑apples, Kwok believes Anthropic’s pricing remains clearly over‑valued. In other words, investors are not only betting on future growth but also accepting that the valuation already reflects very optimistic revenue expectations.

The market is more concerned about whether Anthropic’s rapid growth is beginning to slow. The prospectus shows that revenue year‑over‑year grew over 1,100% in the first nine months of 2026, but quarterly growth fell from 144% in the prior quarter to 47%, indicating that even as revenue expands quickly, the pace has decelerated.

Enterprise AI‑spending data also show a noteworthy signal. Kwok cites Ramp’s tracking data that, for the week ending Nov 15, token spend on Anthropic models by tracked firms rose only 3% from a month earlier, suggesting that corporate spending momentum on the models may be easing.

However, the observation period and release date of that data both precede Anthropic’s IPO, and the sample covers only Ramp‑tracked firms, which cannot represent all Anthropic customers nor prove that overall revenue has stalled. Still, for a company valued at the trillion‑dollar level that must keep high‑speed growth, a slowdown in enterprise usage growth is a warning sign the market will watch.

Beyond usage growth, pricing power is under pressure. Kwok notes that Anthropic’s per‑token price has been steadily declining, indicating the firm may be losing pricing leverage. If model‑service prices keep falling, higher usage may not translate proportionally into revenue or profit.

Profitability highlights the challenge further. Anthropic’s operating margin swung from +8% in Q2 to –3% in Q3, partly due to a sharp rise in energy costs. This means the company can still expand revenue quickly, but compute and infrastructure costs are eroding profit margins.

Even heavier pressure comes from long‑term capital spending. The prospectus states Anthropic has committed roughly $900 billion to chips, cloud services and data‑center related outlays, with more than $70 billion due within the 12 months after September 2026.

These expenditures are essential for maintaining model training, inference services and future compute supply, but they also create massive funding and performance obligations. If enterprise usage keeps growing, scale can help spread costs; but if demand slows and model prices keep dropping, fixed compute purchases and infrastructure commitments could squeeze profits.

Anthropic’s first‑day stock movement also shows market caution. The price surged 34% at the open and briefly pushed the fully‑diluted valuation past $2 trillion, but the rally then tapered and the price slipped below the $111.50 opening level, reflecting some investors taking profits on day one.

On the same trading day, semiconductor and AI‑infrastructure stocks felt the pressure. At the time Kwok’s column was published, NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) were each down 1.6%; AI cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) fell 3.1%; and Nebius (NBIS‑US) dropped 6%.

Market volatility deepened investors’ doubts about AI‑sector valuations. The VIX, a gauge of U.S. market fear, stayed above 25 that week, indicating heightened risk aversion. In that environment, Anthropic’s successful large IPO may not be enough to dispel concerns about AI profitability and capital intensity.

Kwok argues that Anthropic, as the first publicly listed large‑scale machine‑learning model developer, will have each quarterly report serve as a public test of AI business models. Investors will track revenue growth, model usage, pricing power, operating margin and compute spend to judge whether AI firms can turn technical advantage into lasting profit.

For the broader AI industry, Anthropic’s big first‑day jump may temporarily boost confidence and sustain the data‑center and AI‑server investment boom. Yet if enterprise spend slows, model prices keep falling, and infrastructure commitments remain in the hundreds of billions, the market must confront whether AI revenue growth can support such massive capital outlays.

After Anthropic’s listing, the question will no longer be a private‑market valuation debate but will appear directly in quarterly results and stock performance. The $2 trillion first‑day valuation is dazzling, but the real test is whether a sustainable profit model can be built – the true key to extending the AI celebration.

items.title: 外資撤離1152億美元創紀錄！AI晶片雙雄獲利創紀錄　韓股卻深陷「賣出韓國」風暴
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Withdraw Record $115.2 Billion as AI Chip Giants Post Record Profits, Yet Korean Stocks Sink into “Sell Korea” Storm
paras: 南韓股市正面臨近年來最嚴峻的反常困局，儘管兩大權值股三星電子與SK海力士受惠於AI晶片需求爆發，交出創紀錄的財報成績單，但外資卻不為所動，持續大舉撤離，導致南韓綜合股指(KOSPI)經歷罕見的大幅修正。
截至週四(19日)，KOSPI從6月歷史高點累計暴跌44%，約3300兆韓元(約合2.4兆美元)市值灰飛煙滅，今(20)日早盤再挫4%，市場籠罩在恐慌氛圍中。
這波拋售潮規模堪稱空前，外資已連7月淨賣超韓股，累計資金淨流出高達1152億美元，創倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)自2008年開始統計以來的歷史新高。
首爾Kiwoom證券分析師韓志英直言，韓股正面臨全面性的「賣出韓國」趨勢，當務之急是設法重新吸引外資回流。
令人費解的是，韓股大跌與科技巨頭的強勁基本面形成強烈反差。作為全球HBM核心供應商，三星今年第三季營業利潤年增近九倍至107.4兆韓元，SK海力士同期利潤亦暴增逾七倍至83.3兆韓元。兩大巨頭更對後市樂觀，三星估晶片供應緊張恐延續至2028年，SK海力士也認為供需缺口將持續更久。
然而，三星與SK海力士合計佔KOSPI總市值近半，令韓股與全球AI投資週期深度綁定。
新加坡安本亞洲收益基金投資經理Isaac Thong指出，市場正進行明顯的資產輪動，投資人從AI相關資產撤出，轉向防禦性與高品質標的。
Thong強調，不同於過往產業下行週期，目前AI企業基本面依然強勁，這波下跌更多反映的是風險偏好降溫與資金配置的調整。
資金供需失衡更是本輪崩跌的關鍵推手。過去數月，上市公司大規模的庫藏股買回暫時吸收外資賣壓，但隨著回購計畫接近尾聲，市場憂心後續買盤斷炊。三星與SK海力士原規劃2026年股東回報合計上看210兆韓元，三星週四重申仍打算返還最多110兆韓元，SK海力士也堅持約100兆韓元的回購與股利計畫。
不過，南韓散戶歷經多輪重創，短期內恐無力填補資金缺口。此外，此前放大漲勢的SK海力士槓桿ETF，在跌勢中亦加速價格下修。
此外，華爾街對韓股長期價值仍有分歧。高盛本週再度下修KOSPI目標價，從12000點大砍至7500點，理由正是市場不願按基本面給予合理估值，但數據顯示，MSCI南韓指數預期本益比僅約3.27倍，遠低於全球指數的15.35倍，折價幅度顯著。
政治與監管變數亦添亂流。美國期中選舉後民主黨掌握國會，加上華府收緊先進晶片對亞太及拉美夥伴的出口限制，引發AI資料中心監管趨嚴的疑慮。
里昂證券(CLSA)半導體研究主管Sanjeev Rana認為，監管雖可能推高成本、拖慢基建步調，但基於AI對美國經濟與就業的重要性，算力產能仍會逐步到位，2027年企業獲利確定性依然偏高，政治風浪尚未撼動產業中長期前景。
paras_en: South Korean stocks are facing the most severe abnormal crisis in recent years. Despite the two heavyweight stocks Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix benefiting from a surge in AI chip demand and delivering record-breaking financial results, foreign investors remain unmoved, continuing massive withdrawals that have forced the KOSPI to undergo an unprecedented sharp correction.

By Thursday (19th), the KOSPI had fallen a cumulative 44% from its June high, wiping out about 3,300 trillion won (roughly $2.4 trillion) in market value, and on the morning of the 20th it fell another 4%, leaving the market shrouded in panic.

The scale of this sell‑off is unprecedented: foreign investors have been net sellers of Korean stocks for seven consecutive months, with a cumulative net outflow of $115.2 billion, a record high since the London Stock Exchange Group began tracking in 2008.
Kiwoom Securities analyst Han Ji‑yeong bluntly stated that Korean stocks are facing a comprehensive “sell Korea” trend, and the urgent task is to find ways to attract foreign capital back.

It is perplexing that Korean stocks have fallen sharply while the fundamentals of the tech giants remain strong. As the global HBM core supplier, Samsung’s Q3 operating profit rose nearly ninefold to 107.4 trillion won, and SK Hynix’s profit jumped more than sevenfold to 83.3 trillion won. Both giants are optimistic about the future, with Samsung forecasting chip supply tightness to continue until 2028 and SK Hynix expecting the supply‑demand gap to persist longer.
Samsung and SK Hynix together account for nearly half of the KOSPI’s total market value, tying Korean stocks to the global AI investment cycle.

Singapore‑based Abundant Asia Income Fund investment manager Isaac Thong noted that the market is undergoing a clear asset rotation, with investors pulling out of AI‑related assets and shifting to defensive and high‑quality securities.
Thong emphasized that, unlike past industry downturns, AI companies’ fundamentals remain strong; this decline reflects a cooling of risk appetite and a reallocation of capital.

The imbalance between supply and demand of capital is the key driver of this crash. In recent months, large‑scale share buybacks by listed companies temporarily absorbed foreign selling pressure, but as buyback plans near completion, market concerns about future buying have intensified. Samsung and SK Hynix originally planned a combined shareholder return of 210 trillion won by 2026; Samsung reiterated on Thursday that it still intends to return up to 110 trillion won, while SK Hynix also insists on a roughly 100 trillion‑won buyback and dividend plan.

However, Korean retail investors, having suffered multiple rounds of losses, are unlikely to fill the funding gap in the short term. Moreover, the leveraged ETF that amplified SK Hynix’s rally has also accelerated price corrections in the downturn.

Additionally, Wall Street remains divided on the long‑term value of Korean stocks. Goldman Sachs cut its KOSPI target price again this week, slashing it from 12,000 points to 7,500 points, arguing that the market refuses to assign a fair valuation based on fundamentals. Yet data shows the MSCI Korea index’s expected P/E is only about 3.27, far below the global index’s 15.35, indicating a significant discount.

Political and regulatory variables have also added turbulence. After the U.S. midterm elections, the Democratic Party controls Congress, and Washington has tightened export restrictions on advanced chips to Asia‑Pacific and Latin American partners, raising concerns about stricter regulation of AI data centers.

Sanjeev Rana, head of semiconductor research at CLSA, believes that while regulation may raise costs and slow infrastructure development, the importance of AI to the U.S. economy and employment means computing capacity will still gradually come online, and the profitability of enterprises in 2027 remains relatively high; the political turbulence has not yet shaken the medium‑to‑long‑term prospects of the industry.

items.title: 一週內連破四道關卡！受Fed鷹派信號+AI股續跌影響　現貨金價跌破3600美元
items.title_en: Gold Prices Fall Below $3,600 an Ounce in a Week, Breaking Four Key Levels Amid Fed Hawk Signals and AI Stock Declines
paras: 國際現貨金價今(20)日在亞洲早盤交易時段跌破每盎司3600美元大關，較年初所創歷史新高5596美元已跌近2000美元，今年累計跌近36%，本周料將創下3月以來最大跌幅紀錄，因Fed釋放鷹派信號暗示將進一步升息，加上AI股票下跌也促使投資者賣黃金來彌補損失。
現貨金價今日早盤下跌1.35%至每盎司3576美元，本周累跌超過7%，日前一度觸及2025年9月以來的最低水平。與此同時，白銀價格下跌約13%。
現貨金價本周遭遇罕見連續潰敗，週一(16日)盤中跌破3900美元，兩天後又失守3800美元關口，昨(19)日跌勢加速，直線跳水進一步跌破3700美元。
芝加哥聯準銀行總裁Austan Goolsbee週四(19日)成為另一位暗示升息的聯準會官員，稱將考慮所有選項應對美國頑固的通膨。
美國通膨數據超預期後，聯準會(Fed)升息預期持續升溫。根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch最新數據，市場估12月升息1碼機率提升至96.4%，升息2碼的機率為3.6%。
升息預期也推高美債殖利率，10年期殖利率勢將追平2007年一項紀錄，當年收於5%上方天數達29天。利率和殖利率上升通常對黃金不利，因黃金本身不支付利息。此外，美元指數本週上漲0.7%，也讓以美元計價的黃金對大多數買家來說變得更昂貴。
paras_en: International spot gold fell below $3,600 per ounce in Asian early trading on the 20th, a steep drop of nearly $2,000 from the record high of $5,596 set at the beginning of the year and a year‑to‑date decline of almost 36%.  This week is expected to see the largest fall since March, as the Federal Reserve’s hawkish signals hint at further rate hikes and falling AI stocks have prompted investors to sell gold to cover losses.

Spot gold fell 1.35% to $3,576 per ounce in the morning session, a weekly decline of more than 7%, and at one point touched the lowest level since September 2025.  Silver prices fell about 13% during the same period.

Gold has experienced a rare streak of consecutive collapses this week: on Monday the 16th it fell below $3,900, two days later it slipped past the $3,800 mark, and on the 19th the decline accelerated, plunging straight below $3,700.
Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee, on Thursday the 19th, became another Fed official to hint at rate hikes, saying he would consider all options to tackle stubborn U.S. inflation.

After U.S. inflation data surpassed expectations, Fed rate‑hike expectations continued to rise.  According to CME’s FedWatch, the probability of a 1‑basis‑point hike in December rose to 96.4%, while the chance of a 2‑basis‑point hike is 3.6%.

Rate‑hike expectations have also pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher, with the 10‑year yield poised to match a 2007 record, staying above 5% for 29 days that year.  Rising rates and yields are typically negative for gold, which pays no interest, and the dollar index rose 0.7% this week, making dollar‑denominated gold more expensive for most buyers.

items.title: 〈台股開盤〉台積電重挫3%逾百檔個股跌停 賣壓擴大早盤跌逾1500點失守3萬7
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Opens with TSMC Down 3% and Over 100 Stocks Hit 10% Limit
paras: 美股三大指數19日均收跌逾2%，科技股賣壓沉重。台股今（20）日早盤同步走弱，以37646.13點，跳空下跌780.76點，台積電跌近3%，台達電跌逾9%，賣壓由電子權值股擴散至高價股與AI供應鏈，逾100檔個股跌停，最低來到36753.32點，跌近1600點，失守37,000點大關。早盤估量1.01兆元
主要電子權值股全面走跌，台積電 (2330-TW) 以2,035元開出，下跌65元，隨後跌幅略為收斂至約2.74%；聯發科 (2454-TW) 跌約4.37%，台達電 (2308-TW) 重挫逾9%，日月光投控 (3711-TW) 跌近7%。鴻海 (2317-TW)、廣達 (2382-TW) 均跌逾3%。
ASIC概念股跌勢沉重，創意 (3443-TW) 跌停至5,400元，跌幅10%；智原 (3035-TW) 跌逾9%，世芯-KY (3661-TW) 也跌近7%。
銅箔基板股同樣遭遇賣壓，聯茂 (6213-TW) 跌停至355.5元，跌幅10%；台燿 (6274-TW) 跌停至623元，跌幅約9.97%。
記憶體股持續走弱，晶豪科 (3006-TW) 跌逾8%，南亞科 (2408-TW) 跌逾7%。光通訊股聯亞 (3081-TW) 也跌約9.9%，暫報1,365元。
paras_en: US major indices fell over 2% on the 19th, with heavy selling pressure on tech stocks. Taiwan’s market opened weak on the 20th, dropping 780.76 points to 37,646.13. TSMC fell nearly 3%, Delta Electronics fell over 9%, and selling pressure spread from electronic blue‑chips to high‑priced stocks and AI supply chain companies, causing more than 100 stocks to hit the 10% limit. The index fell to a low of 36,753.32, down nearly 1,600 points, and fell below the 37,000‑point threshold. Early‑market volume was estimated at 1.01 trillion TWD.

The main electronic blue‑chips all fell. TSMC (2330‑TW) opened at 2,035, down 65, then narrowed to about 2.74%. MediaTek (2454‑TW) fell about 4.37%, Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) plunged over 9%, and ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW) fell nearly 7%. Foxconn (2317‑TW) and Quanta (2382‑TW) both fell over 3%.
ASIC concept stocks suffered heavy declines. Creative Technology (3443‑TW) hit the 10% limit at 5,400, a 10% drop; Zhi Yuan (3035‑TW) fell over 9%; and Shichin‑KY (3661‑TW) also fell near 7%.
Copper foil substrate stocks also faced selling pressure. Lianmao (6213‑TW) hit the 10% limit at 355.5, a 10% drop; Taiyo (6274‑TW) hit the limit at 623, down about 9.97%.

Memory stocks continued to weaken. Jinghao Technology (3006‑TW) fell over 8%, Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) fell over 7%. Light communication stock Lianya (3081‑TW) also fell about 9.9%, temporarily trading at 1,365.

items.title: 遠傳新創加速器4年育成48家新創 助攻取得投資金額逾7.8億元
items.title_en: FarEasTone Accelerates 48 Startups in 4 Years, Securing Over NT$780 Million in Investment
paras: 遠傳(4904-TW)指出，「遠傳新創加速器」自2022年成立以來，已育成48家新創團隊，協助取得投增資金額逾7.8億元。總經理井琪指出，面對AI快速發展，遠傳將進一步攜手新創夥伴，協助企業從導入AI Agent邁向Agent Ready，加速AI應用落地、產業轉型並拓展全球市場。
資訊長胡德民指出，AI Agent技術快速演進，企業除了掌握關鍵AI技術外，更重要的是建構讓Agent能夠安全、有效且規模化運作的環境，才能真正邁向Agent Ready。遠傳將結合自身企業轉型經驗與新創夥伴的創新能量，包含從AI治理、Physical AI到Agent管理，協助企業加速AI落地，並創造實質商業價值。
遠傳攜手新創團隊聚焦四大方向共創商機，涵蓋發展產品、行銷、人資、研發、財務、法務等企業共通需求的AI應用；深化智慧醫療、智慧建築等產業解決方案；布局企業Agent管理平台所需的大數據、AI治理等基礎建設；拓展結合機器人與硬體的Physical AI，導入醫療、智慧建築等場景，推動AI從數位應用走向實體場域。
遠傳新創加速器自2022年成立以來，以「共創(Co-create)、共銷(Co-sell)、共投(Co-invest)」策略，結合企業創投(CVC)資源，累計扶持48家新創團隊，協助取得投增資金額逾7.8億元，並促成30件企業數位轉型共創案、7項ESG與淨零轉型專案落地。
遠傳也策略投資桓竑智聯、永訊智庫，以及第四期新成員德煌生醫，累計投資金額達新台幣3.6億元。遠傳經營團隊主管長期擔任新創導師，並串聯跨部門資源，迄今已進行逾500場新創門診與深度輔導，協助創業家從技術驗證、商業模式、資金到市場拓展，突破成長挑戰。
paras_en: FarEasTone (4904‑TW) noted that since the establishment of its FarEasTone Startup Accelerator in 2022, it has nurtured 48 startup teams and helped them raise more than NT$780 million in investment. General Manager Jing Qi said that facing the rapid development of AI, FarEasTone will further partner with startups to help companies move from adopting AI Agents to becoming Agent‑Ready, accelerating AI application deployment, industry transformation, and global market expansion.

Chief Information Officer Hu Demin pointed out that AI Agent technology is evolving quickly; beyond mastering key AI technologies, it is more important to build an environment where Agents can operate safely, effectively, and at scale to truly become Agent‑Ready. FarEasTone will combine its own corporate transformation experience with the innovative energy of startup partners, covering AI governance, Physical AI, and Agent management, to help companies accelerate AI deployment and create tangible commercial value.

FarEasTone collaborates with startup teams to focus on four key areas for co‑creating opportunities, covering AI applications that meet common corporate needs such as product development, marketing, HR, R&D, finance, and legal; deepening solutions for smart healthcare and smart building; building the big‑data and AI governance infrastructure required for enterprise Agent management platforms; and expanding Physical AI that combines robotics and hardware, introducing it into medical and smart‑building scenarios to move AI from digital to physical realms.

Since its inception in 2022, the FarEasTone Startup Accelerator has followed a “Co‑Create, Co‑Sell, Co‑Invest” strategy, leveraging corporate venture capital (CVC) resources to support 48 startups, help them raise more than NT$780 million in investment, and facilitate 30 digital‑transformation co‑creation projects and 7 ESG and net‑zero transformation projects.

FarEasTone has also strategically invested in Huanhong ZhiLian, Yongxun ZhiKu, and the fourth‑phase member Dehuang Biomed, with a cumulative investment of NT$360 million. The FarEasTone management team, long‑time startup mentors, has linked cross‑departmental resources and conducted over 500 startup clinics and in‑depth coaching sessions, helping entrepreneurs overcome growth challenges from technology validation and business model to funding and market expansion.

items.title: AI半導體股遭大舉拋售！日經早盤崩逾2700點失守57000點 韓股跌逾4%摔落5000點之下
items.title_en: AI Semiconductor Stocks Suffer Massive Sell-Off! Nikkei Falls Over 2700 Points Early, Dropping Below 57,000; Korean Stocks Decline Over 4% Falling Below 5,000
paras: 日韓股市周五(20日)延續美股昨日大跌走勢，AI族群與半導體股遭猛烈拋售。日經225指數盤中重挫4.5%或2700點，跌破57000點關口，創兩週新低；南韓綜合股指(KOSPI)亦跌超4%。
受美股走勢拖累，東京市場的愛德萬測試、軟銀集團、鎧俠等AI及半導體個股率先遭拋售；首爾方面的SK海力士與三星電子分別跌近7%及5.3%，兩大記憶體巨頭成為重災區。
Anthropic周四(19日)以創紀錄融資規模在那斯達克上市，但未能提振科技股情緒。那指盤中一度上漲逾2%，隨後急轉直下、收跌逾2%。
專家認為，投資人為籌集資金認購Anthropic股票而拋售其他資產，進一步加劇科技股動盪。
此外，東京股市隨後將迎來連續三天假期，假期前的避險情緒明顯升溫，投資者傾向提前減倉以規避海外市場不確定性，令拋售壓力進一步放大。
市場人士指出，在AI族群估值偏高、假期避險與美股波動三重因素交織下，短線日股恐仍將承壓走跌。
paras_en: The Nikkei 225 index plunged 4.5% or 2,700 points in intraday trading on Friday (20th), falling below the 57,000-point threshold and setting a new two‑week low, while the South Korean KOSPI composite index also fell more than 4% as the US market continued its steep decline from the previous day.

In Tokyo, AI and semiconductor names such as AdvanTest, SoftBank Group, and Kyocera were among the first to be sold off; in Seoul, SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics dropped nearly 7% and 5.3% respectively, making the two memory giants the biggest casualties.

Anthropic went public on the Nasdaq on Thursday (19th) with a record‑setting financing round, but it failed to lift tech‑stock sentiment. The Nasdaq rose more than 2% in intraday trading before sharply turning lower and closing down more than 2%.
Experts say that investors sold other assets to raise capital for buying Anthropic shares, further exacerbating volatility in tech stocks.

Additionally, the Tokyo market will soon enter a three‑day holiday period; the heightened risk‑off sentiment before the holidays led investors to trim positions early to avoid overseas market uncertainty, amplifying the selling pressure.
Market participants point out that with AI valuations high, holiday risk‑off, and US market volatility intertwining, short‑term Japanese stocks are likely to continue under pressure and decline.

items.title: 〈國泰金經濟調查〉通膨升溫+AI疑慮再起 11月景氣、股市樂觀指數同步回落
items.title_en: Cathay Financial Economic Survey: Inflation Heating Up, AI Concerns Resurface; November Business and Stock Market Optimism Indices Decline Together
paras: 國泰金控(2882-TW)今(20)日公布11月國民經濟信心調查，受美伊戰爭持續、通膨壓力升溫及AI疑慮再起影響，民眾對景氣前景的樂觀情緒明顯降溫，消費意願同步下滑，景氣現況與展望指數雙雙走低；股市方面，台股樂觀指數及風險偏好指數也同步回落，反映市場信心受到近期國際政經局勢與科技股波動衝擊。
國發會最新公布的9月景氣對策信號續呈紅燈，領先指標及同時指標續呈上升，景氣仍呈穩健成長。但受美伊戰爭持續，增添Fed續升息壓力，且AI擔憂再起，國泰金本月調查顯示，民眾的景氣樂觀指數明顯下降，其中景氣現況樂觀指數下降至-6.3，展望樂觀指數下降至-1.0。大額消費意願指數降至12.1，耐久財消費意願指數降至-9.1。

主計總處於2026年8月14日預估台灣2026年經濟成長率11.05%，通貨膨脹率2.07%。本月調查結果顯示，民眾對於2026年經濟成長率的平均預期值為10.87%，有52%的民眾認為2026年經濟成長率會高於11%；而民眾對於2026年平均通膨預期值為2.51%，且有高達52%的民眾認為2026年通貨膨脹率會高於2.5%。調查結果發現，民眾對於2026年的經濟成長預估與主計總處接近，但通膨預期明顯較高。
美伊戰爭持續且AI擔憂再起，股市樂觀情緒及風險偏好指數下降：10月因美伊戰爭持續，推升通膨壓力，Fed年底可能再升息，且美國CSP財報顯示自由現金流負值擴大、AI擔憂再起，美國科技股大跌帶動台股明顯修正。調查結果顯示，民眾對於台股的樂觀指數降至29.8，風險偏好指數亦下降至26.5，但仍處在相對樂觀水準。

債券ETF是一種在交易所上市的基金，專門投資於一籃子債券。國泰金調查結果顯示，62%民眾有投資債券ETF，51%民眾之投資目的為長期投資、領取配息，另外11%民眾之投資目的為短期投資、賺取價差。在未來投資動向上，有45%民眾在未來一年會維持既有的債券ETF部位不動；近五成民眾傾向未來一年買進債券ETF，其中36%民眾打算買進後持有超過一年才賣出，14%民眾計畫在買進一年內等待機會賣出；僅6%民眾想在未來一年賣出目前的債券ETF部位。
關於影響民眾未來一年債券ETF投資的主要因素，本月的調查結果顯示，27%民眾認為未來一年聯準會升降息為最主要因素，22%民眾會因美國及台灣股市指數表現好壞來決定債券ETF投資，18%民眾主要受川普關稅或財政政策影響。
paras_en: Cathay Financial Holding (2882‑TW) released its November national economic confidence survey today (20th). Ongoing US‑Iran conflict, rising inflation pressure and renewed AI concerns have noticeably cooled public optimism about the economic outlook, with consumer willingness to spend also slipping. Both the current‑condition and outlook indices fell; on the stock‑market side, Taiwan‑stock optimism and risk‑appetite indices also retreated, reflecting market confidence being hit by recent international political‑economic developments and tech‑stock volatility.

The National Development Council’s latest September business‑policy signal remains red, while leading and coincident indicators continue to rise, indicating steady growth. However, the ongoing US‑Iran war adds pressure for further Fed rate hikes, and AI worries have resurfaced. Cathay’s survey this month shows a clear drop in the public’s business‑optimism index, with the current‑condition optimism falling to –6.3 and the outlook optimism to –1.0. The large‑purchase willingness index fell to 12.1 and the durable‑goods purchase willingness index to –9.1.

The Directorate‑General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics estimates Taiwan’s 2026 economic growth at 11.05% and inflation at 2.07% as of August 14, 2026. This month’s survey shows the public’s average expected growth for 2026 at 10.87%, with 52% believing growth will exceed 11%. Expected average inflation for 2026 is 2.51%, and a similarly high 52% expect inflation above 2.5%. Respondents’ growth expectations are close to the official forecast, but inflation expectations are noticeably higher.

The ongoing US‑Iran conflict and revived AI concerns have dampened stock‑market optimism and risk‑appetite indices: In October, the war heightened inflation pressure, the Fed may raise rates again by year‑end, and US CSP earnings showed expanding negative free cash flow and renewed AI worries, causing a sharp drop in US tech stocks and a clear correction in Taiwan stocks. Survey results show the public’s optimism index for Taiwan stocks fell to 29.8 and the risk‑appetite index to 26.5, though both remain at relatively optimistic levels.

Bond ETFs are exchange‑traded funds that invest in a basket of bonds. Cathay’s survey finds 62% of respondents hold bond ETFs; 51% invest for long‑term holding and dividend income, while 11% aim for short‑term gains and price differentials. Looking ahead, 45% say they will keep their current bond‑ETF positions unchanged over the next year; nearly half intend to buy more bond ETFs within a year, with 36% planning to hold purchases for over a year before selling and 14% planning to sell within a year. Only 6% intend to sell their existing bond‑ETF holdings within the next year.

Regarding the main factors influencing bond‑ETF investment over the next year, this month’s survey shows 27% of respondents cite Fed rate moves as the primary driver, 22% say US and Taiwan stock‑market performance will guide their decisions, and 18% say they are mainly affected by Trump‑related tariffs or fiscal policies.

paras: 裕融企業(9941-TW)最新指出，企金事業有看到企業融資和微型金融違約增加，使台灣延滯率回升至1.65%，惟已增提備抵反映風險，且部分大型違約個案擔保品充足，屬實質無損案件，整體資產品質保持穩健且在可控範圍，今(20)日盤中股價相對抗跌。
裕融表示，今年前三季業務動能增溫、資產品質穩定改善且有效成本管理，使獲利穩健成長，截至第三季合併總資產達2964.1億元，較去年同期成長4.7%，而預期信用減損損失大幅年減29%。台灣消金事業資產品質持續改善，已回穩至2022年優良時期水準。
而儘管企金事業雖受企業融資和微型金融違約增加影響，台灣延滯率回升至1.65%，但裕融表示，已增提備抵反映風險，且部分大型違約個案擔保品充足，是實質無損案件，整體資產品質仍保持穩健且在可控範圍。
在中國，裕融說明，延滯率由去年同期的3.15%降至2.25%，新承作案件資產品質已顯著改善，惟當地執行時程仍較緩，呆帳回收效益將遞延顯現。
裕融進一步提到，中國景氣復甦有限、租賃市場競爭加劇壓縮利差空間，所幸資金成本降低且費用控管良好，使前三季在中國的營業利益達1.58億元，較去年同期倍增，未來將聚焦優質客群，穩固資產品質。
而東南亞的投資也值得期待，裕融持續增資產、擴收益，對整體獲利的貢獻度正逐步放大。
paras_en: Yurun Enterprise (9941-TW) recently noted that its corporate finance unit has observed an increase in corporate financing and micro‑finance defaults, causing Taiwan's delinquency rate to climb back to 1.65%. However, the company has raised provisions to reflect the risk, and the collateral for several large default cases is sufficient, making them essentially non‑loss events. Overall asset quality remains sound and within controllable limits, and the stock price held up relatively during midday trading on the 20th.

Yurun said that in the first three quarters of this year, business momentum warmed, asset quality improved steadily, and effective cost management led to solid profit growth. As of the third quarter, total consolidated assets reached NT$296.41 billion, up 4.7% year‑on‑year, and expected credit loss provisions are projected to drop sharply by 29% annually. The consumer finance segment in Taiwan continues to see asset quality improve, returning to the strong levels seen in 2022.

Although the corporate finance unit was affected by the rise in corporate financing and micro‑finance defaults, pushing Taiwan's delinquency rate up to 1.65%, Yurun emphasized that it has increased provisions to reflect the risk and that collateral for several large default cases is ample, rendering them essentially non‑loss events. Consequently, overall asset quality remains robust and within controllable bounds.

In China, Yurun explained that the delinquency rate fell from 3.15% in the same period last year to 2.25%. The quality of newly originated loan assets has improved markedly, though local execution timelines remain slower, delaying the realization of bad‑debt recovery benefits.

Yurun added that the economic recovery in China is limited and intensified competition in the leasing market is compressing margin space. Fortunately, lower funding costs and good expense control helped operating profit in China reach NT$158 million in the first three quarters, more than double the figure from a year earlier. Going forward, the company will focus on high‑quality customers to further solidify asset quality.
Investment in Southeast Asia also looks promising. Yurun continues to increase assets and expand earnings, and its contribution to overall profitability is gradually growing.

items.title_en: Taiwan Stocks See Broad Sell‑off as Both Bulls and Bears Dump, State‑Backed Funds Defend TSMC at NT$2,000 and NT$33 Levels
paras: 台股加權指數今(20)日盤中重挫超過2200點，直接摜破38000、37000點關卡，甚至恐陷入36000點保衛戰，創4月中旬以來新低，跌停家數超過300家，統一投顧分析，盤面因籌碼宣洩未止，引發多殺多無差別賣壓，中長期技術面偏弱勢，底部尚未見到型態確認。
台股加權指數盤中跌幅超過6%，櫃買指數更跌達7.6%，而新台幣開盤即貶破33元價位，最低見到33.04元，與昨日的低點持平顯示中央銀行死守。
其中，千金股中亮跌停燈號的有創意(3443-TW)、健策(3653-TW)、旺矽(6223-TW)、智邦(2345-TW)等，護國神山台積電(2330-TW)也陷入2000元關卡保衛戰。
統一投顧指出，Anthropic 掛牌首日雖大漲約 17%，仍未能化解市場對 AI投資獲利能力、龐大資本支出和融資風險的疑慮，同時，AMD 董事長、總裁兼執行長蘇姿丰於11月 16 日共出售70000 股普通股，加深市場投資人對AI疑慮。
從技術面來看，由於加權指數失守年線，技術指標KD、RSI向下，MACD 維持綠柱體，整體技術面弱勢整理，雖台股短線負乖離率大，加上昨日上市櫃融資大減逾 300億元，浮額大清洗後隨時醞釀短線反彈契機，但提防仍具有一定風險，中長期技術面偏弱勢，尚未能確認底部型態，建議投資人靜待止穩訊號。
paras_en: The Taiwan Capitalization Weighted Index plunged more than 2,200 points during today’s (20th) session, breaking through the 38,000 and 37,000 point thresholds and even threatening a battle to hold above 36,000 points, hitting a new low not seen since mid‑April. Over 300 stocks hit their daily limit down, and Uni-President Securities notes that the market’s sell‑off continued unabated as capital‑flow relief failed to materialise, creating indiscriminate selling pressure from both long and short positions. The medium‑ to long‑term technical outlook remains weak, and a bottom pattern has not yet been confirmed.

The weighted index fell more than 6% intraday, while the OTC index dropped 7.6%. The New Taiwan dollar opened weaker, slipping below the NT$33 mark and touching a low of NT$33.04, matching yesterday’s low and indicating the central bank’s staunch defence of the currency.

Among the so‑called “thousand‑dollar stocks,” the ones that flashed a limit‑down signal included Creative (3443‑TW), Health Strategy (3653‑TW), Wang Silicon (6223‑TW) and Chipbond (2345‑TW). Even the national champion TSMC (2330‑TW) found itself fighting to stay above the NT$2,000 level.

Uni‑President Securities points out that although Anthropic surged about 17% on its debut day, it did not allay market concerns over AI investment profitability, massive capital expenditures and financing risks. At the same time, AMD chairman, president and CEO Lisa Su sold 70,000 shares of common stock on November 16, deepening investors’ AI‑related worries.

From a technical perspective, the weighted index has slipped below its yearly moving average, with the KD and RSI indicators turning down and the MACD remaining in negative (green) bars, indicating overall weak consolidation. Although the market shows a large short‑term negative divergence and yesterday’s listed‑company margin financing shrank by more than NT$30 billion, the massive cleanup of floating shares could set the stage for a short‑term rebound. Nevertheless, risks remain, the medium‑ to long‑term technical outlook stays weak, a bottom pattern is still unconfirmed, and investors are advised to wait for a stabilising signal.

items.title_en: Analysis: Is a 14.5‑Times‑Next‑Year‑Revenue Valuation More Expensive Than SpaceX? How Long Can Anthropic’s IPO Euphoria Last?
paras: 人工智慧新創公司Anthropic (Anthropic) (ANT-US) 19日在那斯達克掛牌，上市首日開盤價達111.50美元，較83美元發行價大漲34%，盤中完全稀釋估值一度衝破2兆美元。然而，亮眼的上市表現背後，營收成長放緩、模型定價能力下降及龐大算力支出等問題，正讓這場AI資本狂歡面臨考驗。
《路透Breakingviews》專欄作家Karen Kwok同日撰文指出，Anthropic上市首日的高估值，可能掩蓋其商業模式尚未穩固的問題。投資人願意以高價買進，卻正值公司成長動能出現降溫跡象，未來能否將龐大融資轉化為持續獲利，仍有很大不確定性。
以111.50美元開盤價計算，Anthropic估值相當於下一財政年度預估營收的14.5倍，相關營收預測來自Needham與Morningstar。相較之下，馬斯克旗下SpaceX (SpaceX) (SPCX-US) 同期股價約為預估營收的9倍，數據來自Visible Alpha。
雖然兩家公司採用的營收預估來源不同，並非完全相同基準的比較，但Kwok認為，Anthropic目前的定價仍明顯偏高。換言之，投資人不只是在押注公司未來成長，也必須接受其估值已提前反映相當樂觀的營收預期。
市場更在意的是，Anthropic的高速成長是否開始減速。根據招股文件，公司2026年前九個月營收年增率超過1,100%，但營收季增率已從前一季的144%降至47%，顯示即使營收仍快速擴張，成長速度已不如先前。
企業客戶的AI支出數據也出現值得留意的訊號。Kwok引用企業支出管理平台Ramp追蹤資料指出，截至11月15日當週，受追蹤企業在Anthropic模型上的Token支出，較一個月前僅增加3%，反映企業使用模型的支出動能可能正在放緩。
不過，這項數據的觀測期間與發布時間均早於Anthropic上市，樣本也僅涵蓋Ramp追蹤的企業，不能直接代表Anthropic全部客戶的支出，更不能據此認定公司整體營收已經停滯。但對一家估值已達兆美元級別、必須持續維持高速成長的企業而言，企業端使用量增幅縮小，仍是市場需要關注的警訊。
除了使用量增長，模型定價能力也面臨壓力。Kwok指出，Anthropic每個Token的收費價格持續下滑，代表公司可能逐漸失去定價能力。若模型服務價格不斷下降，即使客戶使用量增加，也未必能等比例轉化為營收與利潤。
獲利表現則進一步凸顯這項挑戰。Anthropic營業利益率從第二季的8%轉為第三季負3%，部分原因是能源成本大幅上升。這意味著，公司雖然仍能快速擴大營收，但運算與基礎設施成本也可能侵蝕獲利空間。
更沉重的壓力來自長期資本支出。根據招股文件，Anthropic已承諾約9,000億美元的晶片、雲端服務及資料中心相關支出，其中超過700億美元將在2026年9月之後的12個月內到期。
這些支出是維持模型訓練、推理服務及未來算力供應的重要基礎，但也形成龐大的資金與履約壓力。若企業客戶使用量持續成長，公司或許能透過規模擴張分攤成本；但若需求增速放緩、模型價格持續下降，固定的算力採購與基礎設施承諾就可能壓縮利潤。
Anthropic上市首日的股價走勢，也顯示市場並非毫無疑慮。股價開盤一度大漲34%，盤中完全稀釋估值突破2兆美元，但隨後漲幅收斂，股價一度跌破111.50美元的開盤價，反映部分投資人選擇在上市首日獲利了結。
同一交易日，半導體與AI基礎設施相關股票也承受壓力。截至Kwok專欄發布時，輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US) 與博通 (Broadcom) (AVGO-US) 股價均下跌1.6%；AI雲端運算業者CoreWeave (CoreWeave) (CRWV-US) 下跌3.1%，Nebius (Nebius) (NBIS-US) 更下跌6%。
市場波動也加深投資人對AI產業估值的疑慮。衡量美股市場恐慌情緒的VIX指數，當週維持在25以上，代表市場避險情緒偏高。在這種環境下，Anthropic雖然成功完成大型IPO，卻未必能單靠上市首日的亮眼表現，消除市場對AI產業獲利能力與資本支出的擔憂。
Kwok認為，Anthropic是首家上市的大型機器學習模型開發商，未來每一季財報都將成為公開市場檢驗AI商業模式的重要依據。投資人將能持續追蹤營收成長、模型使用量、定價能力、營業利益率及算力支出，判斷AI企業究竟能否將技術優勢轉化為長期獲利。
對整個AI產業而言，Anthropic的上市首日大漲，或許能暫時為市場注入信心，延續資料中心與AI伺服器投資熱潮。但當企業支出增速放緩、模型價格持續下降，而基礎設施承諾仍高達數千億美元，市場終究必須面對一個問題：AI產業的營收成長，是否足以支撐如此龐大的資本投入？
Anthropic上市後，這個問題將不再只是私募市場的估值辯論，而會直接反映在每季財報與股價表現上。首日的2兆美元估值固然耀眼，但能否建立可持續的獲利模式，才是這場AI狂歡能否延續的真正關鍵。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic (ANT‑US) listed on Nasdaq on the 19th, opening at $111.50 – a 34% jump from its $83 issue price – and its fully‑diluted market cap briefly topped $2 trillion during the session. Yet behind the dazzling debut lie slowing revenue growth, weakening pricing power and massive compute spending, casting doubt on the AI capital frenzy.

Reuters Breakingviews columnist Karen Kwok wrote that Anthropic’s lofty first‑day valuation may mask an unsettled business model. Investors are paying a premium just as the company’s growth momentum shows signs of cooling, leaving great uncertainty over whether its huge financing can be turned into sustained profit.

At the $111.50 opening price, Anthropic’s valuation equals about 14.5 times its projected revenue for the next fiscal year, based on forecasts from Needham and Morningstar. By contrast, Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX‑US) traded at roughly 9 times its estimated revenue, according to Visible Alpha.

Although the two firms use different revenue‑forecast sources and the comparison is not perfectly apples‑to‑apples, Kwok believes Anthropic’s pricing remains clearly over‑valued. In other words, investors are not only betting on future growth but also accepting that the valuation already reflects very optimistic revenue expectations.

The market is more concerned about whether Anthropic’s rapid growth is beginning to slow. The prospectus shows that revenue year‑over‑year grew over 1,100% in the first nine months of 2026, but quarterly growth fell from 144% in the prior quarter to 47%, indicating that even as revenue expands quickly, the pace has decelerated.

Enterprise AI‑spending data also show a noteworthy signal. Kwok cites Ramp’s tracking data that, for the week ending Nov 15, token spend on Anthropic models by tracked firms rose only 3% from a month earlier, suggesting that corporate spending momentum on the models may be easing.

However, the observation period and release date of that data both precede Anthropic’s IPO, and the sample covers only Ramp‑tracked firms, which cannot represent all Anthropic customers nor prove that overall revenue has stalled. Still, for a company valued at the trillion‑dollar level that must keep high‑speed growth, a slowdown in enterprise usage growth is a warning sign the market will watch.

Beyond usage growth, pricing power is under pressure. Kwok notes that Anthropic’s per‑token price has been steadily declining, indicating the firm may be losing pricing leverage. If model‑service prices keep falling, higher usage may not translate proportionally into revenue or profit.

Profitability highlights the challenge further. Anthropic’s operating margin swung from +8% in Q2 to –3% in Q3, partly due to a sharp rise in energy costs. This means the company can still expand revenue quickly, but compute and infrastructure costs are eroding profit margins.

Even heavier pressure comes from long‑term capital spending. The prospectus states Anthropic has committed roughly $900 billion to chips, cloud services and data‑center related outlays, with more than $70 billion due within the 12 months after September 2026.

These expenditures are essential for maintaining model training, inference services and future compute supply, but they also create massive funding and performance obligations. If enterprise usage keeps growing, scale can help spread costs; but if demand slows and model prices keep dropping, fixed compute purchases and infrastructure commitments could squeeze profits.

Anthropic’s first‑day stock movement also shows market caution. The price surged 34% at the open and briefly pushed the fully‑diluted valuation past $2 trillion, but the rally then tapered and the price slipped below the $111.50 opening level, reflecting some investors taking profits on day one.

On the same trading day, semiconductor and AI‑infrastructure stocks felt the pressure. At the time Kwok’s column was published, NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) were each down 1.6%; AI cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) fell 3.1%; and Nebius (NBIS‑US) dropped 6%.

Market volatility deepened investors’ doubts about AI‑sector valuations. The VIX, a gauge of U.S. market fear, stayed above 25 that week, indicating heightened risk aversion. In that environment, Anthropic’s successful large IPO may not be enough to dispel concerns about AI profitability and capital intensity.

Kwok argues that Anthropic, as the first publicly listed large‑scale machine‑learning model developer, will have each quarterly report serve as a public test of AI business models. Investors will track revenue growth, model usage, pricing power, operating margin and compute spend to judge whether AI firms can turn technical advantage into lasting profit.

For the broader AI industry, Anthropic’s big first‑day jump may temporarily boost confidence and sustain the data‑center and AI‑server investment boom. Yet if enterprise spend slows, model prices keep falling, and infrastructure commitments remain in the hundreds of billions, the market must confront whether AI revenue growth can support such massive capital outlays.

After Anthropic’s listing, the question will no longer be a private‑market valuation debate but will appear directly in quarterly results and stock performance. The $2 trillion first‑day valuation is dazzling, but the real test is whether a sustainable profit model can be built – the true key to extending the AI celebration.

items.title: AI光模組放量帶動測試需求是德科技第4季接單年增53%
items.title_en: AI Optical Module Volume Boost Drives Test Demand, Keysight Technologies' Q4 Orders Up 53% YoY
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心升級高速網路，光模組廠在量產線上也需要更多測試設備。是德科技Keysight Technologies(KEYS-US)公布，截至10月底的2026財年第4季接單年增53%至23.39億美元，營收年增41%至19.94億美元。排除近12個月併購、處分與匯率影響，接單與營收分別成長49%及36%。調整後每股盈餘為3.61美元，高於去年同期的1.91美元。
高速網路升級推動商用通訊業務營收年增73%至11.45億美元，其中有線通訊營收年增逾一倍。是德科技指出，光模組廠已使用其設備擴大800G與1.6T光模組的生產，在出貨前確認高速訊號能穩定傳輸。這類測試不只發生在產品研發階段，也會隨工廠擴大量產而增加。
是德科技表示，1.6T光模組仍在放量初期，下一代3.2T則已進入研發。2027財年第1季，公司預估營收20.40億至20.60億美元，以中間值計算年增約28%；調整後每股盈餘估為3.63至3.69美元。
不過，接單增加還要看設備能否交付。財務長表示，公司以歷史新高的未交付訂單進入新財年。扣除業務成長自然帶來的積壓，估計另有約2億至3億美元的硬體訂單積壓與供應鏈限制有關，目前需求仍超過公司的出貨能力。

paras_en: November 20, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – As AI data centers upgrade to high‑speed networking, optical‑module manufacturers also need more test equipment on their production lines. Keysight Technologies (KEYS‑US) announced that orders for its fiscal Q4 2026 grew 53% year‑over‑year to $2.339 billion, while revenue rose 41% year‑over‑year to $1.994 billion. Excluding the effects of acquisitions, disposals and currency over the past 12 months, orders and revenue grew 49% and 36% respectively. Adjusted earnings per share were $3.61, up from $1.91 a year earlier.

The upgrade to high‑speed networking drove a 73% year‑over‑year increase in commercial communications revenue to $1.145 billion, with wired‑communications revenue more than doubling. Keysight noted that optical‑module makers are using its equipment to scale production of 800 Gb and 1.6 Tb optical modules, verifying that high‑speed signals can be transmitted reliably before shipment. Such testing occurs not only during product R&D but also increases as factories expand mass production.

Keysight said 1.6 Tb optical modules are still in the early ramp‑up phase, while the next‑generation 3.2 Tb modules have already entered development. For fiscal Q1 2027, the company forecasts revenue of $2.040‑$2.060 billion, implying roughly a 28% year‑over‑year increase at the midpoint, and adjusted EPS of $3.63‑$3.69.

However, the order increase depends on the ability to deliver equipment. The CFO said the company entered the new fiscal year with a record high backlog of undelivered orders. After stripping out the natural backlog from sales growth, an additional $200‑$300 million of hardware orders are tied up by supply‑chain constraints, and current demand still exceeds the company’s shipping capacity.

items.title: 美國司法部結束反壟斷調查NextEra收購Dominion仍待多關審查
items.title_en: U.S. Department of Justice Ends Antitrust Probe; NextEra's Acquisition of Dominion Still Subject to Further Review
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國司法部反壟斷部門11月19日表示，已決定結束對NextEra Energy(NEE-US)收購Dominion Energy(D-US)的調查。這筆5月宣布、規模約668億美元的全股票交易因此跨過一道關卡，但仍未取得完成交易所需的全部監管批准。
Dominion在維吉尼亞州北部供電，當地是全球主要資料中心聚落之一。AI資料中心擴建推升用電需求，也使電廠、輸電線與變電設備必須跟著擴充。NextEra主張，合併後可利用更大的規模與融資能力，支援Dominion在當地建設電力基礎設施。Dominion旗下公用事業仍將由當地團隊經營，並各自接受州監管。
兩家公司股東已於9月3日通過合併案。維吉尼亞州監管機關自11月17日展開聽證，預計最晚於2027年1月11日作出決定；南卡羅來納州則排定12月8日開始聽證，北卡羅來納州也須核准。聯邦層級另外包括聯邦能源監管委員會與核能管理委員會的審查。
兩家公司預計，若取得必要批准，交易可在2027年下半年完成。接下來的重點已從反壟斷調查，轉向各監管機關是否同意交易、以及會附加哪些條件。

paras_en: On November 19, the antitrust division of the U.S. Department of Justice announced that it has decided to close its investigation into NextEra Energy (NEE-US)’s purchase of Dominion Energy (D-US). The all‑stock deal, announced in May and valued at roughly $66.8 billion, therefore clears one hurdle but still lacks all of the regulatory approvals required to complete the transaction.

Dominion supplies power in northern Virginia, an area that is one of the world’s major data‑center clusters. The expansion of AI data centers is driving higher electricity demand, forcing power plants, transmission lines and substations to expand as well. NextEra argues that, after the merger, it can leverage greater scale and financing capacity to support Dominion’s construction of power infrastructure in the region. Dominion’s utility subsidiaries will continue to be run by local teams and will remain subject to state regulation.

The shareholders of both companies approved the merger on September 3. Virginia regulators began a hearing on November 17 and are expected to issue a decision no later than January 11, 2027; South Carolina has scheduled a hearing for December 8, and North Carolina must also approve the deal. At the federal level, the transaction is also subject to review by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission and the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.

Both companies expect that, if the necessary approvals are obtained, the transaction could be completed in the second half of 2027. The focus now shifts from the antitrust investigation to whether the various regulators will consent to the deal and what conditions they may impose.

items.title: 一週內連破四道關卡！受Fed鷹派信號+AI股續跌影響　現貨金價跌破3600美元
items.title_en: Gold Prices Fall Below $3,600 an Ounce in a Week, Breaking Four Key Levels Amid Fed Hawk Signals and AI Stock Declines
paras: 國際現貨金價今(20)日在亞洲早盤交易時段跌破每盎司3600美元大關，較年初所創歷史新高5596美元已跌近2000美元，今年累計跌近36%，本周料將創下3月以來最大跌幅紀錄，因Fed釋放鷹派信號暗示將進一步升息，加上AI股票下跌也促使投資者賣黃金來彌補損失。
現貨金價今日早盤下跌1.35%至每盎司3576美元，本周累跌超過7%，日前一度觸及2025年9月以來的最低水平。與此同時，白銀價格下跌約13%。
現貨金價本周遭遇罕見連續潰敗，週一(16日)盤中跌破3900美元，兩天後又失守3800美元關口，昨(19)日跌勢加速，直線跳水進一步跌破3700美元。
芝加哥聯準銀行總裁Austan Goolsbee週四(19日)成為另一位暗示升息的聯準會官員，稱將考慮所有選項應對美國頑固的通膨。
美國通膨數據超預期後，聯準會(Fed)升息預期持續升溫。根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch最新數據，市場估12月升息1碼機率提升至96.4%，升息2碼的機率為3.6%。
升息預期也推高美債殖利率，10年期殖利率勢將追平2007年一項紀錄，當年收於5%上方天數達29天。利率和殖利率上升通常對黃金不利，因黃金本身不支付利息。此外，美元指數本週上漲0.7%，也讓以美元計價的黃金對大多數買家來說變得更昂貴。
paras_en: International spot gold fell below $3,600 per ounce in Asian early trading on the 20th, a steep drop of nearly $2,000 from the record high of $5,596 set at the beginning of the year and a year‑to‑date decline of almost 36%.  This week is expected to see the largest fall since March, as the Federal Reserve’s hawkish signals hint at further rate hikes and falling AI stocks have prompted investors to sell gold to cover losses.

Spot gold fell 1.35% to $3,576 per ounce in the morning session, a weekly decline of more than 7%, and at one point touched the lowest level since September 2025.  Silver prices fell about 13% during the same period.

Gold has experienced a rare streak of consecutive collapses this week: on Monday the 16th it fell below $3,900, two days later it slipped past the $3,800 mark, and on the 19th the decline accelerated, plunging straight below $3,700.
Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee, on Thursday the 19th, became another Fed official to hint at rate hikes, saying he would consider all options to tackle stubborn U.S. inflation.

After U.S. inflation data surpassed expectations, Fed rate‑hike expectations continued to rise.  According to CME’s FedWatch, the probability of a 1‑basis‑point hike in December rose to 96.4%, while the chance of a 2‑basis‑point hike is 3.6%.

Rate‑hike expectations have also pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher, with the 10‑year yield poised to match a 2007 record, staying above 5% for 29 days that year.  Rising rates and yields are typically negative for gold, which pays no interest, and the dollar index rose 0.7% this week, making dollar‑denominated gold more expensive for most buyers.

items.title: Anthropic、SpaceX相繼在那斯達克掛牌大型新股可望提前迎來ETF買盤
items.title_en: Anthropic and SpaceX Set to Accelerate ETF Buying with Nasdaq IPOs
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ Anthropic與SpaceX今年先後創下IPO募資紀錄，兩家公司都在那斯達克掛牌。那斯達克長期經營科技公司上市業務，今年也新增快速納入機制，讓符合條件的大型新股有機會更早進入那斯達克100指數，追蹤指數的ETF也能更早把它納入持股。
這兩筆大型IPO也拉開了交易所之間的差距。根據Dealogic統計，那斯達克今年已有64宗IPO，募資約2,018億美元；紐約證交所則有42宗，募資約208億美元。兩者的上市件數相差約五成，募資金額卻差近十倍，主要差別在於大型IPO落在哪一家交易所。

那斯達克100／市值夠大，可以不用等滿三個月
新股上市後，通常要等滿三個完整月份（不含上市當月），才符合納入那斯達克100指數的交易時間要求。那斯達克今年5月開了一條快線：上市第7個交易日收盤時，如果公司總市值能排進現有成分股前40名，且上市以來平均每天成交至少500萬美元，就有機會提早納入。符合條件的新股，通常在第10個交易日收盤後公布結果，並在第15個交易日後納入；遇到指數例行調整，時間會另行安排。

SpaceX已有先例Anthropic可能隨12月調整納入
SpaceX在6月掛牌後，已於7月7日納入那斯達克100指數。SpaceX曾把能否提早納入指數列為選擇那斯達克的條件。
Anthropic於11月19日掛牌，依交易日推算，第7個交易日落在11月30日，正好是12月年度調整的評估基準日。若符合快速納入條件，依規則可隨12月21日的年度調整生效，而不是掛牌滿15個交易日就直接納入。接下來要看的，是那斯達克是否正式宣布納入，以及給多少權重。這兩件事，才決定追蹤指數的ETF何時需要調整持股、買進多少。

paras_en: Anthropic and SpaceX both broke IPO fundraising records this year, and both companies are listed on Nasdaq. Nasdaq has long operated a technology‑company listing business and has recently added a fast‑track mechanism that allows qualifying large new issues to enter the Nasdaq 100 index sooner, enabling ETFs that track the index to add them to their holdings earlier.

These two large IPOs have widened the gap between exchanges. According to Dealogic, Nasdaq has had 64 IPOs this year, raising about $201.8 billion, while the New York Stock Exchange has had 42 IPOs, raising about $20.8 billion. The number of listings differs by about 50 %, but the capital raised differs by almost a factor of ten, mainly because large IPOs land on one exchange or the other.

Nasdaq 100/large market cap can be added without waiting three months. After a new issue goes public, it normally must wait three full months (excluding the month of listing) before it meets the trading‑time requirement for inclusion in the Nasdaq 100 index. In May, Nasdaq opened a fast‑track: if, by the close of the seventh trading day after listing, the company’s market cap ranks in the top 40 of the existing constituents and its average daily trading volume since listing is at least $5 million, it may be added early. Qualified new issues usually have their status announced after the close of the tenth trading day and are added after the fifteenth trading day; if the index undergoes a routine rebalancing, the timing will be adjusted accordingly.

SpaceX already set a precedent; Anthropic may be added during the December rebalancing. SpaceX was listed in June and was added to the Nasdaq 100 on July 7. SpaceX had made the possibility of early inclusion a condition for choosing Nasdaq.

Anthropic listed on November 19, and by counting trading days the seventh trading day falls on November 30, which is the assessment date for the December annual rebalancing. If it meets the fast‑track criteria, it would take effect with the December 21 rebalancing rather than after 15 trading days of listing. The next question is whether Nasdaq will officially announce the inclusion and what weight it will assign. Those two decisions determine when ETFs that track the index must adjust holdings and how much to buy.

items.title: IPO是表面利多！彭博經濟學家曝1指標警告：Anthropic IPO定價權正流失 AI行情恐終結
items.title_en: IPO Is a Surface Benefit! Bloomberg Economist Exposes One Indicator Warning: Anthropic IPO Pricing Power Is Losing Grip, AI Market May End
paras: Anthropic大規模IPO被市場視為對AI交易的信心投票，但彭博經濟學家Anna Wong給出相反解讀，認為更像AI行情的「最後一波燃料」，而非新一輪上漲起點。
關鍵證據出現在token經濟學上。自9月以來、也就是招股書財務數據截止日(9月30日)前後，Anthropic每百萬token的實際價格已大幅下滑，同期token使用量雖激增，市場份額卻未同步上升，甚至小幅走低。換言之，該公司讓渡了相當部分價格溢價，卻沒換來更強的競爭地位，技術領先與旺盛需求並未轉化為持久定價能力。
Wong以兩張圖表概括論證道：「實際token價格明顯下行、使用份額略降。這一背離揭示Anthropic所處的市場結構，更像一個不具持久定價權的寡頭，增長必須靠降價驅動用量，而非靠差異化或客戶黏性撐價格。
Wong也直言，「這是一門艱難的生意」，並稱真正考驗在上市之後。IPO會把先進AI的經濟學搬進公開市場，定價、利潤率與資本回報將按季接受審視，此前只存在於私募市場的定價權問題，會被擺上聚光燈。
Wong提示的核心風險是：若後續業績顯示定價能力弱於估值隱含水平，重估可能加速AI板塊整體估值回吐。
宏觀訊號同步收緊。Wong引用Fed常用的Kim-Wright模型指出，市場要求的風險補償利差已明顯擴大，上一業績期中上市公司提及的900多項供應鏈瓶頸，仍有大量尚未緩解。資金面寬鬆或能短期撐住情緒，但基本面對帳的時刻，已經進入倒數。
paras_en: Anthropic’s large-scale IPO is seen by the market as a vote of confidence in AI trading, but Bloomberg economist Anna Wong offers a contrary interpretation, viewing it more as the "last wave of fuel" for the AI market rather than the start of a new rally.

Key evidence emerges in token economics. Since September—around the IPO filing’s financial data cutoff (September 30)—Anthropic’s actual price per million tokens has dropped sharply, while token usage surged, yet market share did not rise in tandem and even fell slightly. In other words, the company ceded a significant portion of its price premium without gaining stronger competitive standing; technological leadership and robust demand did not translate into lasting pricing power.

Wong summarizes her argument with two charts, stating: "The actual token price is clearly declining, and usage share is slightly lower. This divergence reveals Anthropic’s market structure, which resembles an oligopoly without durable pricing power; growth must be driven by price cuts to boost volume, not by differentiation or customer stickiness to sustain prices."

Wong bluntly says, "This is a tough business," and notes that the real test comes after the IPO. The IPO will bring advanced AI economics into the public market, where pricing, profit margins, and capital returns will be scrutinized quarterly—pricing power issues that previously existed only in private markets will now be under the spotlight.
The core risk highlighted by Wong is that if subsequent performance shows weaker pricing power than implied by valuation, a revaluation could accelerate a broader AI sector valuation pullback.

Macro signals are tightening in tandem. Wong cites the Fed’s commonly used Kim‑Wright model, noting that the risk‑premium spread demanded by the market has clearly widened. The 900-plus supply‑chain bottlenecks mentioned by the company in its last earnings period remain largely unresolved. While loose funding may temporarily buoy sentiment, the time for fundamentals to catch up has already begun to run out.

items.title: 劍指輝達！亞馬遜傳70億美元洽購Decart 強化自研晶片戰力
items.title_en: Targeting Nvidia: Amazon Announces $7 Billion Deal to Acquire Decart to Strengthen In-House Chip Capabilities
paras: 以色列財經媒體《Globes》19日報導，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)收購AI新創Decart的談判接近完成，交易金額逾70億美元。這筆交易的競爭切角，在於Decart的軟體技術可能替亞馬遜自研晶片補強效能與開發便利性，挑戰輝達的優勢。
《Globes》報導，交易預計11月26日感恩節前敲定，規劃於11月30日在拉斯維加斯AWS re:Invent大會宣布。
據《華爾街日報》報導，Decart的軟體能讓AI模型在輝達、Google與亞馬遜的晶片上更快運行，並讓開發者更容易在不同晶片之間切換。
《Globes》指出，Decart的優化技術能讓亞馬遜處理器在每度電下運算更多token；《GeekWire》報導，Decart旗下模型已實際搬上亞馬遜的Trainium晶片運行。
Futurum Equities策略師Shay Boloor在10月針對這筆潛在交易評論，亞馬遜等於「買進軟體專業」，意在提升Trainium使用率，讓自研晶片在AI工作負載分散到不同晶片架構時更具吸引力。
《GeekWire》分析，輝達主導AI晶片市場，很大程度來自開發者沿用多年的CUDA軟體；把模型遷移到Trainium等其他晶片原本需要額外工程，Decart的技術正好降低這道門檻。
《Calcalist》報導，亞馬遜發展Trainium自研晶片，意在與主導AI運算GPU市場的輝達競爭，2025年已提前提供Decart試用最新的Trainium 3。
《Globes》報導，這宗收購由亞馬遜副總裁、自研晶片部門Annapurna Labs負責人Nafea Bshara主導。
Annapurna是亞馬遜2015年以3.75億美元收購的以色列晶片公司，如今是Trainium的開發主力。
Decart另一條產品線是Lucy與Oasis等「世界模型」，能以AI即時生成互動3D環境與影片。
公司今年5月估值40億美元，累計募資逾4億美元，投資方包括紅杉資本、Benchmark與Radical Ventures。
《Calcalist》18日引述消息指出，交易最快近期簽署，對價包含現金、股票與遞延支付，部分價款與五年營運目標連動，總價最高接近75億美元；原先談判的估值區間為50億至60億美元。
知情人士說，Decart三位創辦人已承諾留任五年，相當部分價款要到第五年才支付，並同意不另立競業。
這宗收購若成交，將為長達數月的出售案畫下句點。《Calcalist》8月10日率先披露Decart洽談出售；Anthropic隨後洽談以60億美元收購，9月初在完成盡職調查後退出。
《Globes》9月引述接近Decart的人士指出，Anthropic堅持創辦人與核心人才從特拉維夫遷往美國，加上盡職調查出現問題，成為破局的障礙。
Decart其後回頭接觸股東輝達、尋求重啟收購談判，遭輝達婉拒，報導未交代原因；亞馬遜隨後成為新的潛在買家，並對提案正面回應，談判延續至今。
《Globes》與《Calcalist》的報導均引述不具名消息人士，交易尚未簽署，最終金額、條款與時程以正式公告為準。
paras_en: Israeli financial media Globes reported on the 19th that Amazon (AMZN-US) is close to finalising a deal to acquire AI startup Decart for more than $7 billion. The competitive edge of this transaction lies in Decart’s software technology, which could enhance Amazon’s in‑house chip performance and development convenience, challenging Nvidia’s dominance.
Globes said the deal is expected to be sealed before Thanksgiving on November 26 and announced at the AWS re:Invent conference in Las Vegas on November 30.

According to the Wall Street Journal, Decart’s software enables AI models to run faster on Nvidia, Google, and Amazon chips, and makes it easier for developers to switch between different chip architectures.

Globes noted that Decart’s optimisation technology allows Amazon processors to compute more tokens per watt; GeekWire reported that Decart’s models have already been deployed on Amazon’s Trainium chips.

Futurum Equities strategist Shay Boloor commented in October that Amazon is essentially "buying software expertise" to boost Trainium usage, making Amazon’s in‑house chips more attractive when AI workloads are distributed across different architectures.

GeekWire analysis explained that Nvidia’s dominance in the AI chip market largely stems from developers’ long‑standing use of CUDA; moving models to other chips like Trainium previously required extra engineering, and Decart’s technology lowers that barrier.
Calcalist reported that Amazon’s development of the Trainium in‑house chip aims to compete with Nvidia’s leading AI GPU market, and in 2025 it already offered Decart a trial of the latest Trainium 3.
Globes reported that the acquisition is being led by Amazon Vice President and Annapurna Labs head Nafea Bshara, the division responsible for in‑house chips.
Annapurna was acquired by Amazon in 2015 for $375 million and is now the main developer of Trainium.
Decart’s other product line includes world models such as Lucy and Oasis, which can generate interactive 3D environments and videos in real time using AI.
The company was valued at $4 billion in May this year, has raised over $400 million in total funding, and its investors include Sequoia Capital, Benchmark, and Radical Ventures.

Calcalist on the 18th quoted sources saying the deal could be signed soon, with payment consisting of cash, stock, and deferred consideration; part of the payment is tied to five‑year operating targets, bringing the total price close to $7.5 billion. The original valuation range under negotiation was $5 billion to $6 billion.
Insiders said the three founders of Decart have committed to staying for five years, with a significant portion of the payment deferred until year five, and have agreed not to compete elsewhere.

If the acquisition goes through, it would bring an end to a sale process that has lasted months. Calcalist first disclosed Decart’s sale talks on August 10; Anthropic subsequently negotiated a $6 billion purchase but withdrew after completing due diligence in early September.
Globes in September quoted sources close to Decart saying Anthropic insisted that founders and core talent move from Tel Aviv to the U.S., and due diligence issues became a stumbling block.

Decart then approached shareholders Nvidia and sought to restart acquisition talks, which Nvidia declined; Amazon subsequently became a new potential buyer and responded positively, with negotiations continuing to this day.
Both Globes and Calcalist cited unnamed sources; the deal has not yet been signed, and final price, terms, and timeline will be set by official announcements.

items.title: Anthropic掛牌首日大漲17%！市值衝上1.8兆美元空降全球第七大 緊追SpaceX
paras: Anthropic(ANT-US)周四(19日)在那斯達克掛牌首日大漲17%，成為首家上市的前沿人工智慧(AI)實驗室，不只為AI產業寫下重要里程碑，也以1.8兆美元市值躋身全球第七大企業，超車沙烏地阿拉伯石油公司(Saudi Aramco)且緊追在SpaceX(SPCX-US)之後。
Anthropic周三以每股83美元發行9.8億股，募資813億美元，並同步提高此次發行的規模與價格，最終完成史上規模最大的首次公開發行(IPO)，超越SpaceX今年6月創下的歷史紀錄。
這家Claude聊天機器人開發商以股票代號「ANT」交易，開盤價為每股111.50美元，盤中走勢震盪，終場上漲17%至每股97.17美元。
以周四收盤價計算，Anthropic完全稀釋後市值約達1.8兆美元。當天成交股數超過8.46億股，超越SpaceX上市首日的5.22億股。

躋身全球前十大企業

Anthropic的IPO大獲成功，讓公司一舉躋身全球市值最高企業之列，以下為全球市值最高上市公司的最新變化：

蘋果(AAPL-US)，市值5.1兆美元
微軟(MSFT-US)，3.7兆美元
輝達(NVDA-US)，3.5兆美元
Alphabet(GOOGL-US)，3.3兆美元
亞馬遜(AMZN-US)，2.8兆美元
SpaceX(SPCX-US)，1.9兆美元
Anthropic(ANT-US)，1.8兆美元
Saudi Aramco，1.7兆美元

這家成立僅五年的公司，以Claude AI模型及相關產品吸引企業界高度關注，讓身價迅速攀升。Anthropic在公開說明書中表示，在截至9月30日止的九個月期間，營收達332.4億美元，較去年同期暴增1,200%。
Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)於2021年與一小群研究人員離開OpenAI後共同創辦公司。如今OpenAI已成為Anthropic最主要的競爭對手。
Anthropic因在AI安全、監管及國家安全等議題上的立場，面臨外界強烈批評，其中也包括美國總統川普及其他政府高層官員。

items.title: 〈分析〉14.5倍明年營收估值貴過SpaceX Anthropic上市狂歡能撐多久？
items.title_en: Analysis: Is a 14.5‑Times‑Next‑Year‑Revenue Valuation More Expensive Than SpaceX? How Long Can Anthropic’s IPO Euphoria Last?
paras: 人工智慧新創公司Anthropic (Anthropic) (ANT-US) 19日在那斯達克掛牌，上市首日開盤價達111.50美元，較83美元發行價大漲34%，盤中完全稀釋估值一度衝破2兆美元。然而，亮眼的上市表現背後，營收成長放緩、模型定價能力下降及龐大算力支出等問題，正讓這場AI資本狂歡面臨考驗。
《路透Breakingviews》專欄作家Karen Kwok同日撰文指出，Anthropic上市首日的高估值，可能掩蓋其商業模式尚未穩固的問題。投資人願意以高價買進，卻正值公司成長動能出現降溫跡象，未來能否將龐大融資轉化為持續獲利，仍有很大不確定性。
以111.50美元開盤價計算，Anthropic估值相當於下一財政年度預估營收的14.5倍，相關營收預測來自Needham與Morningstar。相較之下，馬斯克旗下SpaceX (SpaceX) (SPCX-US) 同期股價約為預估營收的9倍，數據來自Visible Alpha。
雖然兩家公司採用的營收預估來源不同，並非完全相同基準的比較，但Kwok認為，Anthropic目前的定價仍明顯偏高。換言之，投資人不只是在押注公司未來成長，也必須接受其估值已提前反映相當樂觀的營收預期。
市場更在意的是，Anthropic的高速成長是否開始減速。根據招股文件，公司2026年前九個月營收年增率超過1,100%，但營收季增率已從前一季的144%降至47%，顯示即使營收仍快速擴張，成長速度已不如先前。
企業客戶的AI支出數據也出現值得留意的訊號。Kwok引用企業支出管理平台Ramp追蹤資料指出，截至11月15日當週，受追蹤企業在Anthropic模型上的Token支出，較一個月前僅增加3%，反映企業使用模型的支出動能可能正在放緩。
不過，這項數據的觀測期間與發布時間均早於Anthropic上市，樣本也僅涵蓋Ramp追蹤的企業，不能直接代表Anthropic全部客戶的支出，更不能據此認定公司整體營收已經停滯。但對一家估值已達兆美元級別、必須持續維持高速成長的企業而言，企業端使用量增幅縮小，仍是市場需要關注的警訊。
除了使用量增長，模型定價能力也面臨壓力。Kwok指出，Anthropic每個Token的收費價格持續下滑，代表公司可能逐漸失去定價能力。若模型服務價格不斷下降，即使客戶使用量增加，也未必能等比例轉化為營收與利潤。
獲利表現則進一步凸顯這項挑戰。Anthropic營業利益率從第二季的8%轉為第三季負3%，部分原因是能源成本大幅上升。這意味著，公司雖然仍能快速擴大營收，但運算與基礎設施成本也可能侵蝕獲利空間。
更沉重的壓力來自長期資本支出。根據招股文件，Anthropic已承諾約9,000億美元的晶片、雲端服務及資料中心相關支出，其中超過700億美元將在2026年9月之後的12個月內到期。
這些支出是維持模型訓練、推理服務及未來算力供應的重要基礎，但也形成龐大的資金與履約壓力。若企業客戶使用量持續成長，公司或許能透過規模擴張分攤成本；但若需求增速放緩、模型價格持續下降，固定的算力採購與基礎設施承諾就可能壓縮利潤。
Anthropic上市首日的股價走勢，也顯示市場並非毫無疑慮。股價開盤一度大漲34%，盤中完全稀釋估值突破2兆美元，但隨後漲幅收斂，股價一度跌破111.50美元的開盤價，反映部分投資人選擇在上市首日獲利了結。
同一交易日，半導體與AI基礎設施相關股票也承受壓力。截至Kwok專欄發布時，輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US) 與博通 (Broadcom) (AVGO-US) 股價均下跌1.6%；AI雲端運算業者CoreWeave (CoreWeave) (CRWV-US) 下跌3.1%，Nebius (Nebius) (NBIS-US) 更下跌6%。
市場波動也加深投資人對AI產業估值的疑慮。衡量美股市場恐慌情緒的VIX指數，當週維持在25以上，代表市場避險情緒偏高。在這種環境下，Anthropic雖然成功完成大型IPO，卻未必能單靠上市首日的亮眼表現，消除市場對AI產業獲利能力與資本支出的擔憂。
Kwok認為，Anthropic是首家上市的大型機器學習模型開發商，未來每一季財報都將成為公開市場檢驗AI商業模式的重要依據。投資人將能持續追蹤營收成長、模型使用量、定價能力、營業利益率及算力支出，判斷AI企業究竟能否將技術優勢轉化為長期獲利。
對整個AI產業而言，Anthropic的上市首日大漲，或許能暫時為市場注入信心，延續資料中心與AI伺服器投資熱潮。但當企業支出增速放緩、模型價格持續下降，而基礎設施承諾仍高達數千億美元，市場終究必須面對一個問題：AI產業的營收成長，是否足以支撐如此龐大的資本投入？
Anthropic上市後，這個問題將不再只是私募市場的估值辯論，而會直接反映在每季財報與股價表現上。首日的2兆美元估值固然耀眼，但能否建立可持續的獲利模式，才是這場AI狂歡能否延續的真正關鍵。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic (ANT‑US) listed on Nasdaq on the 19th, opening at $111.50 – a 34% jump from its $83 issue price – and its fully‑diluted market cap briefly topped $2 trillion during the session. Yet behind the dazzling debut lie slowing revenue growth, weakening pricing power and massive compute spending, casting doubt on the AI capital frenzy.

Reuters Breakingviews columnist Karen Kwok wrote that Anthropic’s lofty first‑day valuation may mask an unsettled business model. Investors are paying a premium just as the company’s growth momentum shows signs of cooling, leaving great uncertainty over whether its huge financing can be turned into sustained profit.

At the $111.50 opening price, Anthropic’s valuation equals about 14.5 times its projected revenue for the next fiscal year, based on forecasts from Needham and Morningstar. By contrast, Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX‑US) traded at roughly 9 times its estimated revenue, according to Visible Alpha.

Although the two firms use different revenue‑forecast sources and the comparison is not perfectly apples‑to‑apples, Kwok believes Anthropic’s pricing remains clearly over‑valued. In other words, investors are not only betting on future growth but also accepting that the valuation already reflects very optimistic revenue expectations.

The market is more concerned about whether Anthropic’s rapid growth is beginning to slow. The prospectus shows that revenue year‑over‑year grew over 1,100% in the first nine months of 2026, but quarterly growth fell from 144% in the prior quarter to 47%, indicating that even as revenue expands quickly, the pace has decelerated.

Enterprise AI‑spending data also show a noteworthy signal. Kwok cites Ramp’s tracking data that, for the week ending Nov 15, token spend on Anthropic models by tracked firms rose only 3% from a month earlier, suggesting that corporate spending momentum on the models may be easing.

However, the observation period and release date of that data both precede Anthropic’s IPO, and the sample covers only Ramp‑tracked firms, which cannot represent all Anthropic customers nor prove that overall revenue has stalled. Still, for a company valued at the trillion‑dollar level that must keep high‑speed growth, a slowdown in enterprise usage growth is a warning sign the market will watch.

Beyond usage growth, pricing power is under pressure. Kwok notes that Anthropic’s per‑token price has been steadily declining, indicating the firm may be losing pricing leverage. If model‑service prices keep falling, higher usage may not translate proportionally into revenue or profit.

Profitability highlights the challenge further. Anthropic’s operating margin swung from +8% in Q2 to –3% in Q3, partly due to a sharp rise in energy costs. This means the company can still expand revenue quickly, but compute and infrastructure costs are eroding profit margins.

Even heavier pressure comes from long‑term capital spending. The prospectus states Anthropic has committed roughly $900 billion to chips, cloud services and data‑center related outlays, with more than $70 billion due within the 12 months after September 2026.

These expenditures are essential for maintaining model training, inference services and future compute supply, but they also create massive funding and performance obligations. If enterprise usage keeps growing, scale can help spread costs; but if demand slows and model prices keep dropping, fixed compute purchases and infrastructure commitments could squeeze profits.

Anthropic’s first‑day stock movement also shows market caution. The price surged 34% at the open and briefly pushed the fully‑diluted valuation past $2 trillion, but the rally then tapered and the price slipped below the $111.50 opening level, reflecting some investors taking profits on day one.

On the same trading day, semiconductor and AI‑infrastructure stocks felt the pressure. At the time Kwok’s column was published, NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US) were each down 1.6%; AI cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) fell 3.1%; and Nebius (NBIS‑US) dropped 6%.

Market volatility deepened investors’ doubts about AI‑sector valuations. The VIX, a gauge of U.S. market fear, stayed above 25 that week, indicating heightened risk aversion. In that environment, Anthropic’s successful large IPO may not be enough to dispel concerns about AI profitability and capital intensity.

Kwok argues that Anthropic, as the first publicly listed large‑scale machine‑learning model developer, will have each quarterly report serve as a public test of AI business models. Investors will track revenue growth, model usage, pricing power, operating margin and compute spend to judge whether AI firms can turn technical advantage into lasting profit.

For the broader AI industry, Anthropic’s big first‑day jump may temporarily boost confidence and sustain the data‑center and AI‑server investment boom. Yet if enterprise spend slows, model prices keep falling, and infrastructure commitments remain in the hundreds of billions, the market must confront whether AI revenue growth can support such massive capital outlays.

After Anthropic’s listing, the question will no longer be a private‑market valuation debate but will appear directly in quarterly results and stock performance. The $2 trillion first‑day valuation is dazzling, but the real test is whether a sustainable profit model can be built – the true key to extending the AI celebration.

items.title: 外資撤離1152億美元創紀錄！AI晶片雙雄獲利創紀錄　韓股卻深陷「賣出韓國」風暴
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Withdraw Record $115.2 Billion as AI Chip Giants Post Record Profits, Yet Korean Stocks Sink into “Sell Korea” Storm
paras: 南韓股市正面臨近年來最嚴峻的反常困局，儘管兩大權值股三星電子與SK海力士受惠於AI晶片需求爆發，交出創紀錄的財報成績單，但外資卻不為所動，持續大舉撤離，導致南韓綜合股指(KOSPI)經歷罕見的大幅修正。
截至週四(19日)，KOSPI從6月歷史高點累計暴跌44%，約3300兆韓元(約合2.4兆美元)市值灰飛煙滅，今(20)日早盤再挫4%，市場籠罩在恐慌氛圍中。
這波拋售潮規模堪稱空前，外資已連7月淨賣超韓股，累計資金淨流出高達1152億美元，創倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)自2008年開始統計以來的歷史新高。
首爾Kiwoom證券分析師韓志英直言，韓股正面臨全面性的「賣出韓國」趨勢，當務之急是設法重新吸引外資回流。
令人費解的是，韓股大跌與科技巨頭的強勁基本面形成強烈反差。作為全球HBM核心供應商，三星今年第三季營業利潤年增近九倍至107.4兆韓元，SK海力士同期利潤亦暴增逾七倍至83.3兆韓元。兩大巨頭更對後市樂觀，三星估晶片供應緊張恐延續至2028年，SK海力士也認為供需缺口將持續更久。
然而，三星與SK海力士合計佔KOSPI總市值近半，令韓股與全球AI投資週期深度綁定。
新加坡安本亞洲收益基金投資經理Isaac Thong指出，市場正進行明顯的資產輪動，投資人從AI相關資產撤出，轉向防禦性與高品質標的。
Thong強調，不同於過往產業下行週期，目前AI企業基本面依然強勁，這波下跌更多反映的是風險偏好降溫與資金配置的調整。
資金供需失衡更是本輪崩跌的關鍵推手。過去數月，上市公司大規模的庫藏股買回暫時吸收外資賣壓，但隨著回購計畫接近尾聲，市場憂心後續買盤斷炊。三星與SK海力士原規劃2026年股東回報合計上看210兆韓元，三星週四重申仍打算返還最多110兆韓元，SK海力士也堅持約100兆韓元的回購與股利計畫。
不過，南韓散戶歷經多輪重創，短期內恐無力填補資金缺口。此外，此前放大漲勢的SK海力士槓桿ETF，在跌勢中亦加速價格下修。
此外，華爾街對韓股長期價值仍有分歧。高盛本週再度下修KOSPI目標價，從12000點大砍至7500點，理由正是市場不願按基本面給予合理估值，但數據顯示，MSCI南韓指數預期本益比僅約3.27倍，遠低於全球指數的15.35倍，折價幅度顯著。
政治與監管變數亦添亂流。美國期中選舉後民主黨掌握國會，加上華府收緊先進晶片對亞太及拉美夥伴的出口限制，引發AI資料中心監管趨嚴的疑慮。
里昂證券(CLSA)半導體研究主管Sanjeev Rana認為，監管雖可能推高成本、拖慢基建步調，但基於AI對美國經濟與就業的重要性，算力產能仍會逐步到位，2027年企業獲利確定性依然偏高，政治風浪尚未撼動產業中長期前景。
paras_en: South Korean stocks are facing the most severe abnormal crisis in recent years. Despite the two heavyweight stocks Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix benefiting from a surge in AI chip demand and delivering record-breaking financial results, foreign investors remain unmoved, continuing massive withdrawals that have forced the KOSPI to undergo an unprecedented sharp correction.

By Thursday (19th), the KOSPI had fallen a cumulative 44% from its June high, wiping out about 3,300 trillion won (roughly $2.4 trillion) in market value, and on the morning of the 20th it fell another 4%, leaving the market shrouded in panic.

The scale of this sell‑off is unprecedented: foreign investors have been net sellers of Korean stocks for seven consecutive months, with a cumulative net outflow of $115.2 billion, a record high since the London Stock Exchange Group began tracking in 2008.
Kiwoom Securities analyst Han Ji‑yeong bluntly stated that Korean stocks are facing a comprehensive “sell Korea” trend, and the urgent task is to find ways to attract foreign capital back.

It is perplexing that Korean stocks have fallen sharply while the fundamentals of the tech giants remain strong. As the global HBM core supplier, Samsung’s Q3 operating profit rose nearly ninefold to 107.4 trillion won, and SK Hynix’s profit jumped more than sevenfold to 83.3 trillion won. Both giants are optimistic about the future, with Samsung forecasting chip supply tightness to continue until 2028 and SK Hynix expecting the supply‑demand gap to persist longer.
Samsung and SK Hynix together account for nearly half of the KOSPI’s total market value, tying Korean stocks to the global AI investment cycle.

Singapore‑based Abundant Asia Income Fund investment manager Isaac Thong noted that the market is undergoing a clear asset rotation, with investors pulling out of AI‑related assets and shifting to defensive and high‑quality securities.
Thong emphasized that, unlike past industry downturns, AI companies’ fundamentals remain strong; this decline reflects a cooling of risk appetite and a reallocation of capital.

The imbalance between supply and demand of capital is the key driver of this crash. In recent months, large‑scale share buybacks by listed companies temporarily absorbed foreign selling pressure, but as buyback plans near completion, market concerns about future buying have intensified. Samsung and SK Hynix originally planned a combined shareholder return of 210 trillion won by 2026; Samsung reiterated on Thursday that it still intends to return up to 110 trillion won, while SK Hynix also insists on a roughly 100 trillion‑won buyback and dividend plan.

However, Korean retail investors, having suffered multiple rounds of losses, are unlikely to fill the funding gap in the short term. Moreover, the leveraged ETF that amplified SK Hynix’s rally has also accelerated price corrections in the downturn.

Additionally, Wall Street remains divided on the long‑term value of Korean stocks. Goldman Sachs cut its KOSPI target price again this week, slashing it from 12,000 points to 7,500 points, arguing that the market refuses to assign a fair valuation based on fundamentals. Yet data shows the MSCI Korea index’s expected P/E is only about 3.27, far below the global index’s 15.35, indicating a significant discount.

Political and regulatory variables have also added turbulence. After the U.S. midterm elections, the Democratic Party controls Congress, and Washington has tightened export restrictions on advanced chips to Asia‑Pacific and Latin American partners, raising concerns about stricter regulation of AI data centers.

Sanjeev Rana, head of semiconductor research at CLSA, believes that while regulation may raise costs and slow infrastructure development, the importance of AI to the U.S. economy and employment means computing capacity will still gradually come online, and the profitability of enterprises in 2027 remains relatively high; the political turbulence has not yet shaken the medium‑to‑long‑term prospects of the industry.

items.title: AI光模組放量帶動測試需求是德科技第4季接單年增53%
items.title_en: AI Optical Module Volume Boost Drives Test Demand, Keysight Technologies' Q4 Orders Up 53% YoY
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心升級高速網路，光模組廠在量產線上也需要更多測試設備。是德科技Keysight Technologies(KEYS-US)公布，截至10月底的2026財年第4季接單年增53%至23.39億美元，營收年增41%至19.94億美元。排除近12個月併購、處分與匯率影響，接單與營收分別成長49%及36%。調整後每股盈餘為3.61美元，高於去年同期的1.91美元。
高速網路升級推動商用通訊業務營收年增73%至11.45億美元，其中有線通訊營收年增逾一倍。是德科技指出，光模組廠已使用其設備擴大800G與1.6T光模組的生產，在出貨前確認高速訊號能穩定傳輸。這類測試不只發生在產品研發階段，也會隨工廠擴大量產而增加。
是德科技表示，1.6T光模組仍在放量初期，下一代3.2T則已進入研發。2027財年第1季，公司預估營收20.40億至20.60億美元，以中間值計算年增約28%；調整後每股盈餘估為3.63至3.69美元。
不過，接單增加還要看設備能否交付。財務長表示，公司以歷史新高的未交付訂單進入新財年。扣除業務成長自然帶來的積壓，估計另有約2億至3億美元的硬體訂單積壓與供應鏈限制有關，目前需求仍超過公司的出貨能力。
